paragraphs.text: Native Web Browser Automation Agent Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — Everything is a Plugin
> **Native Headless & Visible Web Browser Automation Agent Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**
`dsh-plugin-browser` empowers DeepSeek Harness agents with native web browsing, live page content ex
traction, DOM parsing, form interaction, and visual screenshot verification.

- 🌐 **Web Navigation & Exploration**: Navigate to any public or internal website URL.
- 📄 **Semantic

Markdown & Link Extraction**: Convert complex HTML pages into clean, token-efficient Markdown.
- 📸

**Visual Screenshots**: Capture high-resolution visual snapshots for multi-modal verification.
- 💻 *
